Chapter 34: Conclusion 34 Conclusion All the texts of the Tipit.aka , including the Abhidhamma, are not meant merely for intellectual study or memorizing, they are directed to the practice, the development of vipassan¯a. All the classifications of cittas, cetasikas and r¯upas are terse reminders of the truth, they are an exhortation to develop understanding of what appears at this moment. This is the development of the eightfold Path leading to the eradication of all defilements.
